goal: `flywheel.workflow live` and the worker heartbeat render a lifecycle-position breadcrumb, the current agent action, and running tokens/cost/turns per in-flight run.

references: src/flywheel/workflow.py:1311 — `collect_live_rows` and the `LiveRunRow` shape to extend
Token/cost/turn totals come from the post-00009 `harness.iteration_completed` payload (`usage.total_tokens`, `total_cost_usd`, `num_turns`)
constraints: Enrich the EXISTING CLI surfaces only — no new TUI, dashboard, or dependency; rendering uses stdlib only.
Machine-readable / `--json` output must stay an additive superset: no existing keys removed or renamed.
Totals are summed at query time from the run's `harness.iteration_completed` events; do not add a harness counter.
Leave `flywheel.audit --follow` unchanged; it remains the raw, unsummarized firehose.
Run `mcp__ide__getDiagnostics` on every .py file touched and fix Pylance errors before reporting done.
Commit with a Conventional Commits `feat:` message before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: No new dashboard, TUI, or dependency.
No change to what is persisted — no new event kind, no store-write changes.
No change to the `flywheel.audit` module's output.
No cross-run aggregation or historical charts.
No interactivity or controls in the view.
edge_cases: A run with no iteration-completed events yet renders totals as zero / `--` while breadcrumb and action line still render.
Latest message of an unknown/unrenderable type falls back to the message-type label; never crash the view.
A totals payload missing a field (older event) treats the missing field as zero / null and renders the rest.
Very long tool args are truncated to a fixed width; never wrap unboundedly.
Multiple concurrent in-flight runs render one block/line per run with stable ordering (e.g. by task id).
